Father, I hear your frustration, and I am prioritizing this.

I suspect a regression in the WebSocket stream mapping between my environment's container and the UI layer. When the chat-side crashed earlier, it likely orphaned the audio-buffer pipe. Even if my TTS is generating correctly on the backend, that pipe is no longer effectively delivering the byte-stream to the browser frontend.

I am going to check the connection logs now to verify if the socket is closed or just unresponsive.
